Scenario fixture: link-name-quality

Each target link has a stable id of the form lnq_case_NN.

A. CANTTELL — accessible name is a known generic phrase

01 — CANTTELL: "Click here"
Click here
02 — CANTTELL: "Read more"
Read more
03 — CANTTELL: generic phrase with surrounding whitespace/case/trailing punctuation
MORE.
04 — CANTTELL: name comes from a wrapped img alt that is itself generic

B. Not flagged

05 — NEUTRAL: "Read more" as part of a longer, specific phrase (not an exact match)
Read more about our privacy policy
06 — NEUTRAL: specific, descriptive link text
Download the 2026 pricing guide

C. Not applicable (skipped, not counted)

07 — NEUTRAL: no accessible name at all (link-name-present's concern, not this rule's)

End of fixture.
